title: MORE Than You Expected
story:
On **June 29, 2022**, j-hope released **"MORE,"** the pre-release single from his upcoming album **Jack In The Box**. From the very first moments, it was clear that this was not the sound many people expected from him.

THE HUNGER FOR MORE

Driven by heavy drums, distorted guitar sounds, and an intense old-school hip-hop atmosphere, the song revealed a rawer, more aggressive side of j-hope. Its message was just as direct: he wanted **MORE**.

More music. More creativity. More challenges. More opportunities to grow. He was not interested in staying within the limits of what people already knew about him. The song expressed the ambition and hunger that had been hidden inside the box, waiting to come out.

The music video reflected this feeling through dark, surreal imagery. j-hope moves through a strange building filled with boxes, confined spaces, and unsettling scenes. It is as if the world around him is trying to define where he belongs, while he is determined to push beyond those boundaries.

FROM MORE TO ARSON

Then came **"Arson,"** released together with the full album on **July 15, 2022**. If "MORE" was about the desire to break out and keep growing, "Arson" explored what happens after that breakthrough.

In interviews, j-hope explained that the **fire in the song represented the passion he had ignited for his career and music**. But that passion had grown so powerful that the world around him seemed to be burning, too. Now he was standing at a crossroads: should he put out the fire he had started, or let it burn even brighter?

He chose "Arson" as the album's final track because it brought together so much of what he wanted to express. He described it as a turning point, a crossroads, and a period at the end of a sentence - a conclusion to the story he had told through **Jack In The Box**.

TWO SONGS, ONE JOURNEY

The two songs reveal different stages of the same journey. "MORE" is the hunger to go beyond expectations. "Arson" is the difficult question that follows when you finally break free: where do you go from here?

j-hope was not content with simply proving that he could do something different. He wanted to explore how far he could go, even if the next step was uncertain.

And that is what makes these songs so powerful: he wasn't asking for less. He was demanding **MORE**.
surpriseDescription: Two powerful tracks, one unforgettable performance. Watch j-hope set the stage on fire with “MORE” and “Arson” at the 2022 MAMA Awards!

challenge.question: What choice does j-hope face in "Arson"?
options: Whether to return to the musical style of Hope World or create a new mixtape.
Whether to put out the fire of his passion or let it burn even brighter.
Whether to continue making music or focus only on dancing.
challenge.answer: Whether to put out the fire of his passion or let it burn even brighter.
challenge.explanation: j-hope explained that the fire represents the passion he had ignited for his career and music. In "Arson," he stands at a crossroads, wondering whether to extinguish it or let it burn even more.
